newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 180.53/58.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 180.53/58.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday after range trading throughout the afternoon session, dealers said.
"The forint followed the dollar/mark which moved in a very narrow range today," said Zoltan Kalman, of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
The forint closed at 180.53/58 to the dollar, compared with 180.35/40 at the opening and 180.55/60 at midday. The gap that separated it from the central bank's bid was a minimal two pips.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
